You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From d549c66766ee42175e2f4a47219b4103ddab4ffa Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thierry Reding <treding@nvidia.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2021 13:33:27 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] dt-bindings: net: dsa: sja1105: Fix indentation warnings

Some of the lines aren't properly indented, causing yamllint to warn
about them:

    .../nxp,sja1105.yaml:70:17: [warning] wrong indentation: expected 18 but found 16 (indentation)

Use the proper indentation to fix those warnings.

Signed-off-by: Thierry Reding <treding@nvidia.com>
Fixes: 070f5b701d559ae1 ("dt-bindings: net: dsa: sja1105: add SJA1110 bindings")
Tested-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20210622113327.3613595-1-thierry.reding@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Rob Herring <robh@kernel.org>
---
 Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/dsa/nxp,sja1105.yaml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/dsa/nxp,sja1105.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/dsa/nxp,sja1105.yaml
index 0b8a05dd52e6..f978f8719d8e 100644
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/dsa/nxp,sja1105.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/net/dsa/nxp,sja1105.yaml
@@ -67,8 +67,8 @@ properties:
           reg:
             oneOf:
               - enum:
-                - 0
-                - 1
+                  - 0
+                  - 1
 
         required:
           - compatible
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by improper indentation in the YAML file, which led to warnings from yamllint about the expected indentation not matching the actual indentation. This issue was specifically related to the formatting of the enum values under the 'reg' property in the device tree bindings for the SJA1105 network switch.
